features.text: Provides static therapy to support, protect, and position the ankle and foot
Delivers gentle, progressive extension stretch therapy
Helps manage mild to moderate plantar flexion, inversion, and eversion contractures
Adjustable dorsiflexion strap provides enhanced ankle and foot stretching
Flexible construction supports comfortable in-bed orthotic therapy
Extra-padded footplate provides added comfort and protection
Adjustable toe post helps protect and position the toes
Hip rotation bar helps manage internal and external hip rotation
Helps maintain neutral hip positioning while the patient is in bed
Non-skid bottom provides added stability during assisted transfers

measurement: Size Foot Length Maximum Calf Circumference Small 6 to 8 inches 15 inches Medium 8 to 10 inches 17 inches Large 10 to 11 inches 19 inches X-Large 11 to 12 inches 23 inches For the best fit, measure the length of the foot and the circumference of the widest part of the calf before selecting a size.
